entities.name: Ranar
entities.description: An old warrior who died protecting refugee children, wakes as a spirit in Istfell, and is repeatedly named guardian of the realm.

entities.name: Egon
entities.description: The god of the dead and lord of Istfell, who poses as the youth Bjorn of Beskir to trick Ranar into helping him kill three kings and force his way into Starnheim.

entities.name: Firja
entities.description: A Valkyrie of singular authority with two sets of wings who judges who may enter Starnheim and who stops Egon.

entities.name: Bear King
entities.description: The heroic, sad-eyed guardian king of the final tower of Istfell, who commands the Ursan Guard and is killed by Egon.

entities.name: Crow King
entities.description: A spirit king of a city on a perch in Istfell, guarded by the Feather Guard, who is killed by Bjorn.

entities.name: Elk King
entities.description: A petty Istfellian king whose crown of braided iron elk antlers Bjorn claims after killing him.

entities.name: The wolf at the end of the world
entities.description: A titanic wolf in the Cosmos whose eyes shine like twin green suns over Istfell and who watches Ranar and Bjorn.

entities.name: Istfell
aliases: the realm of the ignoble dead
entities.description: The afterlife of those who lived mundane lives, a pale green tundra and cairn-strewn realm beneath the roots of the World Tree.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: The golden realm of heroes, whose light shines above Istfell and which Valkyries grant entry to.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: The great tree from which the realms grew; its roots form the lattice above Istfell.

entities.name: Cosmos
entities.description: The starry void around Istfell and the realms where the wolf wanders.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: A magical path between realms that swallowed the village Ranar guarded.

entities.name: Valkyries
entities.description: The judges who decide the afterlife of the dead and usher heroes into Starnheim.

entities.name: Ursan Guard
entities.description: The Bear King's armored guards, killed by Ranar and Bjorn.

entities.name: Feather Guard
entities.description: The Crow King's feather-cloaked guards with curved black swords, killed by Ranar and Bjorn.

entities.name: King's Guard
entities.description: The borealis-armored guards of the Elk King.

entities.name: Demons
entities.description: Horned, black-armored raiders: Ranar died fighting them in life, and two demon guards at a river of spirits are killed by him.

entities.name: Cairn-eaters
entities.description: Thousands of unfettered spirits who tear down stone cairns built as a tribute to Egon.

entities.name: Beskir
entities.description: The people Bjorn claims to come from.

events.summary: Ranar wakes as a spirit on an endless tundra with arrows in his chest and realizes he is dead.
events.quote: Ranar opened his eyes to find himself in an inglorious place.

events.summary: Ranar remembers dying in battle against demon raiders after seeing the last of his children to safety (flashback).
events.quote: A pile of demonic dead, and Ranar's duty complete.

events.summary: Ranar realizes the Valkyries have judged him to Istfell instead of Starnheim and resolves to prove his worth there.
events.quote: Without horror, he realized he was in an afterlife unexpected: Istfell.

events.summary: Ranar throws his axe to choose his direction and sets off walking.
events.quote: The haft pointed the way.

events.summary: Ranar sees the wolf at the end of the world, decides not to fight it, and salutes it as it leaves.
participants: The wolf at the end of the world
events.quote: Ranar raised his axe above his head in quiet salute

events.summary: A withered spirit warns Ranar of the cairn-eaters, who tear down a monument built as tribute to Egon.
events.quote: I realized for EGON this tribute, and my reward was the hatred of these most lost souls

events.summary: Ranar finds demons guarding a river of marching spirits and refuses their order to move on.
events.quote: These were not spirits but demons of some kind.

events.summary: Ranar kills both demon guards with his axe.
events.quote: The strength of Ranar's swing threw the demon away from the column, where it landed with a heavy thud on the ground, dead.

events.summary: The river of freed spirits tells Ranar they are free and then dissolves into mist.
events.quote: the entirety of it began to drift into mist

events.summary: Ranar reaches the gates and bridge of Istfell and waits there for centuries as guardian.
events.quote: He had followed his axe and could go no farther.

events.summary: A living-looking youth appears on the bridge and introduces himself as Bjorn of Beskir, asking Ranar's help on a quest.
events.quote: My name is Bjorn of Beskir, and I am not supposed to be here

events.summary: Ranar accepts the quest and feels life begin to return to him.
events.quote: Life, distant, nevertheless had begun to fill him like liquid fills a vessel.

events.summary: Bjorn reveals he means to climb a tower built by his ancestors and cut open a passage to Starnheim, and orders Ranar to follow.
events.quote: Now I will climb it, and with this sword cut open a passage to Starnheim.

events.summary: Ranar and Bjorn cut through the Elk King's guard and Bjorn kills the Elk King, taking his crown.
events.quote: He plunged his dagger into the spirit's neck and levered him to the floor.

events.summary: Bjorn explains that he must slay three kings, the crow next and the bear last, to open Starnheim.
events.quote: We take the crow next, and last the bear, and then Starnheim opens to me.

events.summary: Ranar's hands become whole and flesh-colored as the kills restore life to him.
events.quote: His hands, once the faded green of spiritflesh, were made whole.

events.summary: The wolf at the end of the world returns and watches the two leave the Elk King's keep.
participants: The wolf at the end of the world
events.quote: The wolf at the end of the world had returned from its wandering.

events.summary: Ranar and Bjorn fight the Feather Guard at the Crow King's perch and Ranar cuts the Crow King down.
events.quote: before Ranar landed a mortal blow with his axe, sending the Crow King to the ground

events.summary: Bjorn stabs the wounded Crow King, and the city's people vanish.
events.quote: Bjorn plunged his sword into the Crow King's belly.

events.summary: Ranar finds the city empty and begins to suspect Bjorn's quest is wrong.
events.quote: The city below was empty.

events.summary: Ranar realizes Bjorn killed his own kin and came to Istfell on purpose; Bjorn replies that he makes his own fate.
events.quote: You did this on purpose, didn't you?

events.summary: At the foot of the Bear King's tower they find a mummified body speared with a banner reading CLIMB.
events.quote: Unraveled, it had a single word painted upon it: CLIMB.

events.summary: Ranar and Bjorn reach the roof and face the Bear King and his Ursan Guard, who say they guard Istfell from threats within and without.
events.quote: Ranar and Bjorn stood before the Bear King and his final Ursan Guard.

events.summary: Together they slay the Ursan Guard.
events.quote: Together they slew the Ursan Guard.

events.summary: Bjorn lets the Bear King's swing land on Ranar, breaking his axe and wounding him.
events.quote: Bjorn slid under the king's opening swing, leaving Ranar to take the blow.

events.summary: Bjorn cuts the Bear King's leg and drives his sword into the king's chest.
events.quote: Bjorn drove his sword up through a layer of the Bear King's mail and into his chest.

events.summary: Bjorn sheds his disguise and is revealed as Egon, god of the dead.
events.quote: In his place stood the very lord of Istfell himself, Egon, god of the dead

events.summary: Egon beheads the Bear King with his scythe.
events.quote: Egon pressed the king forward into the blade of his scythe.

events.summary: Egon opens a rent into Starnheim, showing the golden realm.
events.quote: Starnheim was open before them.

events.summary: The Valkyrie Firja arrives and seals the rent, refusing Egon entry.
events.quote: The light of Starnheim vanished, the rent in the cosmos sealed shut.

events.summary: Firja tells Egon he must remain in Istfell.
events.quote: You will remain in Istfell.

events.summary: Ranar offers Firja his broken axe and asks to keep guarding; she grants it and the axe is repaired with Valkyrie metal.
events.quote: Ranar stood, marveling as his axe repaired itself in his hands.

events.summary: At Firja's command, Ranar strikes down Egon with one blow.
events.quote: he swung his axe, striking down the God of Death in a single blow.

events.summary: Firja explains Egon will return to his throne in time and that Ranar has played this part in a cycle many times.
events.quote: You are an integral part of this cycle.

events.summary: Firja tells Ranar to serve the realm well and flies into Starnheim's light.
events.quote: Serve this realm and its people well, Ranar of Istfell.

events.summary: Ranar returns to spirit form, throws his repaired axe, and sets off to guard Istfell.
events.quote: Alone, the guardian of Istfell pulled his axe free and set off toward the far horizon.

relations.note: Ranar strikes Egon down at Firja's command; Egon will revive.
relations.quote: he swung his axe, striking down the God of Death in a single blow.

relations.note: Egon kills the Bear King, his former servant, with his scythe.
relations.quote: Egon pressed the king forward into the blade of his scythe.

relations.note: Bjorn, Egon in disguise, stabs the Crow King.
relations.quote: Bjorn plunged his sword into the Crow King's belly.

relations.note: Bjorn, Egon in disguise, kills the Elk King.
relations.quote: He plunged his dagger into the spirit's neck and levered him to the floor.

relations.note: Egon calls the Bear King a good servant.
The Bear King stands in rank with his Ursan Guard.
relations.quote: Standing in rank with his Ursan Guard, he towered over the largest of them by a head

relations.note: Egon is the lord of Istfell.
relations.quote: In his place stood the very lord of Istfell himself, Egon, god of the dead

relations.note: Firja repeatedly stops Egon from entering Starnheim.
relations.quote: a voice like a choir, a war cry, split the moment.

relations.note: Ranar fought raiding demons in life and kills demon guards in Istfell.
relations.quote: A pile of demonic dead, and Ranar's duty complete.

relations.note: Firja names Ranar guardian of Istfell and tells him to guard it.
relations.quote: Ranar, guard your realm. Strike him down.
